'''Galladinium's 51st edition''' was the fifty-first edition of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''. Coupons for special offers that were offered in [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|the 50th anniversary edition]] could only be redeemed until the publication of the 51st edition.<ref name="GFT" />
